cards.context: Hook injury may cause hypothenar pain and ulnar-distribution tingling.

cards.front: Which nerve is vulnerable behind the medial bony elbow prominence? [___]
cards.context: The ulnar nerve passes behind the medial epicondyle, where it is relatively superficial and vulnerable to impact.
